svg.aria-label: System architecture of the DC microgrid black-start controller
svg.title: System architecture of the DC microgrid black-start controller
svg.text: System architecture: DC solar microgrid black-start controller
Three layers: the laptop proves the logic, the ESP32 runs it, the power hardware obeys it.
1 · LAPTOP: design, simulation and verification (MATLAB, Python, g++)
GATE DRIVERS (3x TC4427): 3.3 V GPIO signal to 12 V MOSFET gate. The E-stop cuts their 12 V, so everything switches off.
sensor signals from the blue boxes
Blue boxes: sensors (analog to the ESP32). Green boxes: switches (driven by the ESP32 through the gate drivers).
